title: Pinterest API Pricing: Complete Guide for 2026
snippet:
The headline is short: Pinterest does not publish API access fees for v5. No price card, no per-call meter, no subscription fee.
**Is the Pinterest API free in 2026?** Both the Trial and Standard tiers cost nothing, so on price the answer is a flat yes. The three things that actually gate you are non-monetary: the Trial-to-Standard video-demo review, the per-category rate ceilings, and a data-storage rule that bars caching most API data and quietly breaks a few product designs. If you only need to create and schedule Pins, a unified layer like [Blotato](https://blotato.com/pricing?ref=in-body-text-links) skips the review entirely, and its [Pinterest MCP server](https://blotato.com/mcp/pinterest) lets Claude Code and other AI agents post to Pinterest without an OAuth flow of your own.

| Access tier | Cost | Best for | Key friction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trial access (v5) | Free | Building and testing against a sandbox before launch | Universal cap of 1,000 req/day per app across all endpoints, with `ads_write` stricter at 300/day. Pins are hidden from the public. Product-limited test tokens expire after 24 hours |
| Standard access (v5) | Free | Production publishing, ads, catalogs, analytics | Manual review of a video demo, approval criteria are not published as a fixed checklist |
| Marketing Developer Partners (MDP) | Not publicly priced. Limited, curated program. | Software companies publishing on behalf of brands at scale | Pinterest’s own description calls MDP a “limited, carefully selected group of developer partners” |
| Ads API (inside v5, Standard tier) | Free | Building and reporting on Pinterest ad campaigns at scale | Standard access required, must comply with the developer guidelines’ fee-disclosure rules |
| Third-party read APIs (Bright Data, scraper services) | Pricing varies by vendor and volume | Off-platform research, competitive data, public-pin discovery at scale | Outside Pinterest’s terms in many cases, check each vendor’s compliance posture before you build on top |

The current [rate limits page](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/reference/rate-limits/) lists them per category, in plain numbers. `ads_read` and `org_read` sit at 1,000 requests/minute per user per app. `ads_write` sits at 400. `advanced_auction_write` sits at 25.

**Trial caps stack: universal + per-category.** Pinterest enforces a universal Trial cap of 1,000 requests/day per app across all endpoints, AND stricter per-category caps. Most categories run at 1,000

title: Pinterest API Guide 2026: Setup, Pins and Rate Limits
snippet:
Every new application begins at the Trial level, which limits the total number of unique users who can authenticate with the app. Once an application exceeds the minimum threshold for active users and demonstrates stable error rates, you can apply for Standard access.
Moving to the Standard tier increases the per-minute request limits, allowing a business to scale its automated pinning strategies.

### Is there a cost for using the Pinterest API?
Standard access to the Pinterest API v5 is currently provided at no financial cost to developers who successfully complete the app review process. While there's no per-request fee, the platform enforces strict rate limits based on the application's tier.

title: Pinterest API: pins, boards and the approval you need first
snippet:
Two tiers, no others. From Pinterest's [access tiers guide](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/key-concepts/access-tiers/), read today:
| | Trial | Standard |
|---|---|---|
| Positioning | "best for exploring our API features" | "get the full functionality that our API offers" |
| Can read and create | ads, audiences, boards, Pins, catalogs | same |
| Visibility of what you create | boards and Pins visible only to their creator | normal public visibility |
| Rate limit window | daily, per app | per minute, per user, per app |
| All API requests | 1,000 per day | 100 per second per user per app |
| Organic reads (`org_read`) | 1,000 per day | 1,000 per minute |
| Organic writes (`org_write`) | 300 per day | 100 per minute |
| Ads reads (`ads_read`) | 1,000 per day | 1,000 per minute |
| Ads writes (`ads_write`) | 300 per day | 400 per minute |

### Is the Pinterest API free?
Pinterest does not publish a price for API access. What it rations is requests and visibility: Trial access caps you at 1,000 requests a day per app and keeps the boards and Pins you create visible only to their creator, while Standard moves the limits to 100 requests per second per user per app. Ads endpoints still require an ad account.

title: Pinterest API Guide 2026: v5 Access, Pins & Limits
snippet:
**Short answer:** Pinterest API v5 is a free REST API at `api.pinterest.com/v5`. Your app starts on Trial access, where Pins you create are visible only to you and calls are capped at 1,000 a day. Standard access, granted after a video demo, makes Pins public. A Pin is one `POST /v5/pins`; video needs an upload step first.

Every app has an access tier, and the tier changes both who sees your Pins and how fast you can call the API:
| | Trial access | Standard access |
|---|---|---|
| How you get it | Default tier once your app is approved | Upgrade request with a video demo of your app |
| Pins and boards you create | Visible only to the creator, as Sandbox entities | Public, like any other Pin |
| Rate limits | Per day, per app: 1,000 requests for all calls | Per minute, per user, per app: 100 requests per second overall |
| Endpoints | Same as Standard | Same as Trial |
| Right for | Building and testing | Anything real users rely on |
Sources: [access tiers](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/key-concepts/access-tiers/) and [rate limits](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/reference/rate-limits/). Read 29 September 2026.

| Limit | Trial access | Standard access |
|---|---|---|
| All requests | 1,000 per day | 100 per second per user per app |
| `org_write` (create Pins, boards) | 300 per day | 100 per minute |
| `org_read` | 1,000 per day | 1,000 per minute |
| `org_analytics` | 1,000 per day | 60 per minute |

The Free plan is free forever with no card: 10 uploads a month and 2 profiles, with Pinterest and API access included. Paid plans with unlimited uploads start at $24 a month ($16 billed annually). Compare options in the [social media API overview](https://upload-post.com/social-media-api/).
## Frequently asked questions
### Is the Pinterest API free?
Pinterest does not charge for API access. What limits you is the access tier: Trial access is capped at 1,000 requests a day and everything you create is private to you, and Standard access, which lifts both, requires a review with a video demo of your app.

Free forever plan. No credit card. 10 uploads a month.
